campaign.core_idea: Celebrate the cricket season with themed dessert boxes and custom cakes that bring the excitement of the match to your living room.
campaign.target_audience_angle: Cricket fans and social butterflies in Karachi who are hosting or attending match-night gatherings and want to enhance the experience with themed treats.

execution_directions.direction: Create special cricket-themed dessert boxes, including mini cupcakes and bento cakes decorated with team colors and cricket motifs.
execution_directions.why_it_works: This taps into the excitement of cricket season and offers a unique, Instagrammable product that aligns with Velvet Crumbs' aesthetic and custom design strengths.

execution_directions.direction: Partner with local sports bars or cafes hosting match screenings to offer exclusive Velvet Crumbs dessert packages for attendees.
execution_directions.why_it_works: This expands reach to a wider audience and positions Velvet Crumbs as the go-to bakery for cricket celebrations, leveraging the social aspect of match nights.

execution_directions.direction: Run an Instagram contest where customers share photos of their cricket-themed desserts during match nights for a chance to win a custom cake.
execution_directions.why_it_works: Encourages user-generated content and increases social media engagement, while showcasing the brand's creativity and quality.

formats.primary_text: 🏏 Ready for some cricket magic? 🎂 Our Cricket Cravings dessert boxes are here to make your match nights extra special! Dive into mini cupcakes and bento cakes decorated in your team's colors. Perfect for hosting or attending match gatherings. Place your order now and be the star of the night! 📞 #CricketCravingsVibes
formats.call_to_action: Order your cricket-themed dessert box today!
formats.notes: Post with eye-catching photos of the cricket-themed desserts for best engagement.

Show a table set for a match night with desserts. On-screen text: 'Order now and be the match night hero! Visit velvetcrumbs.pk'

formats.notes: Use a trending cricket chant sound to boost engagement.

campaign.core_idea: Leverage the ongoing heatwave to position Glowly's climate-specific skincare products as essential for maintaining healthy, hydrated skin in extreme conditions.
campaign.target_audience_angle: Women aged 20-35 in the UAE who are struggling with skincare issues due to the prolonged heatwave, looking for effective solutions tailored to their climate.

execution_directions.direction: Create an Instagram and TikTok series showing a day-in-the-life of someone using Glowly products to combat the heatwave.
execution_directions.why_it_works: Visual content showcasing real-life applications will resonate with the audience's current struggles and highlight product effectiveness.

execution_directions.direction: Offer a limited-time 'Heatwave Essentials Kit' bundle featuring the gel cleanser, barrier moisturizer, and SPF 50 at a special price.
execution_directions.why_it_works: A curated kit directly addresses the immediate needs of the audience, providing a convenient solution during the heatwave.

execution_directions.direction: Host a live Q&A session on Instagram with a dermatologist discussing skincare tips for extreme heat and how Glowly products can help.
execution_directions.why_it_works: Expert advice will build trust and educate the audience, aligning with Glowly's professional and transparent brand tone.

formats.primary_text: Struggling in this Dubai heatwave? 🌞 Combat the heat with Glowly's Heatwave Essentials Kit: Hydrating Gel Cleanser, Barrier Repair Moisturizer, & SPF 50 Daily Sunscreen. Formulated for the Gulf's toughest conditions. Ready to glow? Tap to shop now!
formats.notes: Post this during peak engagement times for maximum visibility.

campaign.core_idea: As petrol prices rise, cash flow tightens. Khaata helps small shop owners manage udhaar seamlessly, ensuring they stay afloat during tough times.
campaign.target_audience_angle: Small retail and wholesale shop owners who are feeling the pinch of rising petrol prices and need efficient credit management solutions.

execution_directions.direction: Launch a Facebook campaign featuring testimonials from shop owners who successfully manage udhaar with Khaata, even during price hikes.
execution_directions.why_it_works: Testimonials build trust and show real-world success, resonating with shop owners facing similar challenges.

execution_directions.direction: Create a WhatsApp broadcast message offering a free month trial of the PKR 1,500/month plan to help shop owners manage their finances more effectively.
execution_directions.why_it_works: A free trial lowers the barrier to entry and encourages shop owners to try Khaata without financial risk.

execution_directions.direction: Host a live Q&A session on Facebook about managing business finances during economic challenges, featuring local experts.
execution_directions.why_it_works: Engaging directly with the audience provides value and positions Khaata as a supportive partner in tough times.

formats.primary_text:
